rv.q: This dazzling Broadway tour is a feast for the eyes and ears, overflowing with glitter, glamour, romance, and enough theatrical magic to leave audiences spellbound from the opening moments until the final curtain.
It's extra in the best possible way.
This is an absolute must-see if you, 'Can. Can. Can.'
This production is the quintessential date night for the holidays; a show for the ages that should not be missed.
Overall, it is a fantastic show, and I heartily encourage everyone to experience it for themselves if they can-can-can!
This second go-round of the show's national tour is, simply put, a helluva good time.
Overall, Moulin Rouge!: The Musical is a high energy, sexy extravaganza that thrills.
The energy stays relentless from the first beat, turning the performance into a vivid celebration of truth, freedom, and love.
This dazzling production that is a feast for the eyes and ears.
For students, families, and anyone needing a spark of joy in difficult times, this show delivers that in spades.
Moulin Rouge! The Musical is a masterful production all around, with many big showstopping musical numbers.
"Moulin Rouge! The Musical” is Broadway’s thrilling high-energy party with a glitzy, glamorous shimmer.
The direction by Alex Timbers is always crisp, and Sonya Tayeh’s choreography is sensuous and bold, making this a treat for the eyes as well as the ears.

The multi-Tony Award-winning show, onstage in a national tour presentation at the Orpheum in San Francisco through Dec. 28, is simply a treat for pop music fans of all ages.
Give yourself over to a hothouse over-the-top fantasy spun from the music engraved in your brain.
The show is pure fun and fantasy, and very well done.
The whole thing is brought together by Director Alex Timbers and it may not be as complex as the Normandy landings but it is a lot more enjoyable.
Moulin Rouge! The Musical a fun, romantic romp
In the end, Moulin Rouge: The Musical! is a fairy tale, a dream of bohemian idealism that never quite made its way to the waking world.
It’s a dazzling experience, though one that might leave enthusiasts of the original film wanting more in terms of emotional depth.

cn.t: Critics praise Moulin Rouge! The Musical as a dazzling, spectacular sensory experience, with lavish visuals, glittering production design, and cleverly reworked pop songs creating an overwhelmingly entertaining jukebox musical.
